A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 13-page versions of QuantVLA. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–G support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original LIBERO experiments, quantization ablations, memory measurements, and additional Pick-and-Can and OpenVLA evaluations in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–7 and the calibration and memory analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same selective quantization layout, Attention Temperature Matching, and Output Head Balancing. The calibration procedures and inference operations are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four LIBERO suites and the Pick-and-Can evaluation identified with Simpler in the main text. The OpenVLA evaluation on LIBERO-Spatial is also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: full-precision baselines and DuQuant remain in the main comparisons, and SmoothQuant remains in the corresponding Appendix E and F comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported precision settings, model configurations, layer-selection controls, denoising-step evaluations, and success metrics are unchanged. Section 4.1 and the appendix settings contain no protocol revisions.

E4.justification: The selective-layer ablations in Table 1, ATM/OHB analysis in Figure 3, precision and denoising-step tests in Tables 3–4, and additional applicability analyses are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate and success-count reporting. Neither introduces repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The reported results are unchanged, including Table 2's QuantVLA averages of 97.6% for π0.5 and 88.0% for GR00T N1.5, Table 6's 27/50 successes, and Table 7's 86.0%. Visual inspection also confirms unchanged values in Figure 1.

T1.justification: The first-order quantization-error analysis, calibration equations, and mathematical formulations in Appendices A–C are unchanged. No definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, training-free quantization, accuracy, and memory-saving claims. The small wording correction does not alter their meaning or scope.

C2.justification: The scale-drift interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged. Both retain Appendix F's acknowledgment of performance below the floating-point baseline and Appendix G's restriction on applying DiT-specific ATM/OHB to OpenVLA.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix D retain identical hardware, quantization, and calibration details. The added Research Hub link points to a paper page; it supplies no new implementation instructions or code/data-access disclosure.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, 56-reference bibliography, and positioning relative to VLA efficiency frameworks and existing PTQ methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 updates author affiliations and front-matter links. It also restores the missing subject in Section 4.4, changing 'achieves substantial memory reduction' to 'QuantVLA achieves substantial memory reduction'; the remaining narrative and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The title-page affiliation and link layout changes, with link icons and a Research Hub entry. Figure 1's existing performance panel shifts slightly, and the corrected efficiency paragraph reflows; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v4 repairs one incomplete sentence and makes small affiliation, navigation, and layout edits. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, mathematical analysis, and appendix documentation remain unchanged, so these editorial adjustments do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
